decisions.statement: Every readout here is read off the folder the opened day is kept in.
A readout states which of that folder's three files the readout is made from.
A readout read off the open block is made from the stretches file alone.
A readout read off the day row is made from the day file and the file beside it.
A readout read off the day row moves with every other day's page too.
The day row is in the commit.
A day page's own file says that day row has moved.
A stretch is beside its day rather than in the commit.
The stretches file says a stretch has moved.
The safety and the cost read the open block alone and move with no values.
The surplus is made from the stretches too.
The surplus fall rate turns as a stretch opens.
The constitution counts food entries and moves with every food entry's page.
The food entry page type is spelled here rather than asked of its reader.
The reading each readout takes is the one its own reading module takes.
Readouts one read answers together share that read rather than each making one.
The sites a reading is carried to are named here rather than held as a secret.
The folder followed is worked out again whenever the opened day rolls.
The day followed is the day Alan opened rather than the day on the clock.
The folders the day pages and the food entries sit in are followed for a folder appearing.
The watch is renewed at the instant the opened day ends.
A renewal takes every reading again.
A day folder that was not there when the watch opened is followed once it is.
No timer takes these readings, this watch being the only taker of them.
Where every page named here sits is asked of the index rather than spelled.
Nothing here works out a reading.
Nothing here follows the index.
Nothing here dispatches a change to a readout.
Every readout here is taken again on a beat as well as when its files move.
The beat is there so a round landing says the watch is alive and working.
A round that landed writes the moment beside this watch's own service page.
That moment is written after the readouts answering nothing are written.
A readout answering nothing carries the moment it began to, beside the readout itself.
Nothing is written for a readout whose answering is what it already was.
A beat writes one moment however many readouts the watch has.
A take on the beat that finds the value before it writes no reading.
No reading here is shown or withheld for how old that reading is.
The plant grams count food entries and move with every food entry's page.

definition: the readouts read off Alan's opened day, taken again as that day's files change
